name: uvm.public.dappnode.eth
description: UVM — Urbit Vere Manager. Development candidate for one Urbit ship with owner-CA private HTTPS, authenticated onboarding and explicit Start. Not yet qualified for Dappnode installation or legacy upgrades. Embedded Vere dependency risk remains disclosed; license, namespace registration and signed release delivery remain release gates.
gettingStarted:
**UVM — Urbit Vere Manager** manages one Urbit ship on Dappnode. It keeps the ship's pier in persistent storage and provides a private manager for owner enrollment, stopped-pier import, and explicit Start/Stop. Installing UVM does not create or automatically start a ship.

Use the private Admin link for management; the separate Landscape link opens the running ship. Follow the [owner operator guide](https://github.com/OwlWilderness/dappnode-urbit/blob/master/docs/operator-guide.md) for trusted HTTPS and existing-pier setup. Keep credentials and pier contents private. Public ship access needs a separately configured connector; UVM administration stays private.
author: androolloyd <opensource@andrewredden.com> (https://github.com/androolloyd)

warnings.onInstall: Development candidate, not an approved in-place upgrade. Preserve existing ship_data. Legacy or unknown volume layouts refuse startup without migration. Provision only public CA certificates and authority digests; never upload private CA or ship keys. No ship starts automatically.
warnings.onReset: Resetting storage can destroy the ship. Preserve a verified stopped-state backup first.
warnings.onRemove: Keep ship_data and a verified stopped-state backup. Never run two copies of the same ship.
